summary: Approve. Targeted recheck of round 2 only. All 14 round 2 findings are fixed (R2-01 to R2-14). Checked against decisions_r1/r2, the two era 10 apply files and the new saved pages. R2-01: openQuestion is null on all 17 decisions. R2-02 and R2-03: Kongo and New France now match each other and the CO-3 ruling. Both are living, graded none, with no presentBody and no descent grade, and outcome is kept. R2-04: the UCC history quote is in ucc_hist.html (and f_hist.html), and its canonical URL matches the one cited. R2-05, R2-06, R2-07, R2-11, R2-13 and R2-14 are applied word for word. R2-12 is applied; the cross-reference cites subject and date. R2-08: f_mt.html's canonical URL and published_time (2025-02-12) match the corrected citation, and the quote is on the page. R2-09: the staging item is gone, and the 2013 Madhyamam report alone gives CR. R2-10: each extended quote, date stamp included, is on its saved page (mospat matches once the non-breaking spaces are normalized). The reviser's two notes are both acceptable. (1) The amp URL is the same article: its canonical tag names /en/node/8985, its datePublished is 2013-02-11, and it can be fetched and checked, which the looping en URL cannot. (2) VI.31's openQuestion offers the Wendake link as a question, says plainly that no source in hand shows it, and goes to Open-Gaps rather than into the public basis. That is the honest form for an unproven link, not a claim. The round 2 revision introduced nothing wrong. Two cosmetic record-keeping points remain. Totals: 0 substantial, 2 cosmetic, no change orders.
